title: WhatsApp Business Platform gets costlier from today: What Indian businesses need to know about new messaging charges
snippet: Meta has changed WhatsApp Business Platform pricing as of 1 October, making service messages chargeable in India after the monthly free quota. Indian businesses get 1,000 free service messages per phone number each month, after which they will pay  ₹0.115 per delivered message.

title: Google Fitbit Air launches in India: Screen-free tracker brings heart-rate, sleep, fitness monitoring
snippet: Google has launched the Fitbit Air in India at  ₹13,999, with sales starting 2 October through the Google Store and retail partners. The screen-free tracker offers 24/7 heart rate monitoring, AFib alerts, SpO2, sleep tracking and up to seven days of battery life.

title: Fed's Lisa Cook sees AI inflationary push as a top 2027 risk
snippet: Cook joined a unanimous vote last month at the Fed to raise the policy rate by a quarter of a point to support a "timelier" return of inflation to the Fed's 2% goal. Inflation by the Fed's targeted measure was 3.4% in August and has been above the goal for more than 5-1/2 years.
